1.w: For the one directing. Of David. A Psalm. A Song. God Arises, His enemies are scattered, and those hating Him flee before His face.

2.w: As smoke is driven away, you will drive [them] away; like the melting of wax from the face of the fire, the wicked will perish before the face of God.

3.w: And the righteous will be glad; they will exult before God, and will rejoice exceedingly.

4.w: Sing to God, sing praises [to] His name! Lift up to the One riding on the clouds—YAH [is] His name—and rejoice before His face!

5.w: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of widows, [is] God, in the habitation of His holiness.

6.w: God causes the solitary to dwell in a home; He brings out the prisoners into prosperity, but the rebellious ones have dwelt in a scorched land.

7.w: O God, in Your going forth before the face of Your people, in Your marching through the wilderness, Selah

8.w: the earth shook; also the heavens poured down before the face of God, the One of Sinai, before the face of God, the God of Israel.

9.w: You showered rain of freewill offerings, O God; when Your inheritance was weary, You restored it.

10.w: Your community dwelt in it; You provided for the poor from Your goodness, O God.

11.w: The Lord gives speech, [and] those bearing news were a great army:

12.w: “The kings of the armies—they flee, they flee! And she who dwells [in] the house divides the spoil!

13.w: Though you⁺ lie down among the sheepfolds—the wings of the dove are covered with silver, and her pinions with yellow gold.”

14.w: When Shaddai scattered the kings in it, it was as the snow on Zalmon.

15.w: A mountain of God [is] Mount Bashan; a mountain of peaks [is] Mount Bashan!

16.w: Why do you⁺ gaze in envy, O mountains of peaks? On the mountain [where] God desires to dwell, YHWH indeed will dwell forever.

17.w: The chariots of God [are] myriads—thousands upon thousands! The Lord [is] among them [on] Sinai, in the sanctuary.

18.w: You have gone up to the height, You have led captive captivity; You have received gifts from man, even [from] the rebellious ones, that YAH God may dwell there.

19.w: Blessed [be] the Lord, [who] day [by] day lifts us up—the God of our salvation! Selah

20.w: God [is] unto us a God of salvation, and from YHWH the Lord [is] [our] coming forth from death.

21.w: Surely God will wound the head of His enemies, the hairy crown of the one walking in his guilt.

22.w: The Lord said, “From Bashan I will bring [them] back; I will bring [them] back from the depths of the sea,

23.w: so that [you] may plunge your foot in the blood, [and] the tongue of your dogs have its portion from [your] enemies!”

24.w: They have seen Your going about, O God, the going about of my God [and] my King, in the sanctuary.

25.w: Those singing go in front, [and] behind [are those] playing strings, [and] in the midst [are] virgins playing timbrels.

26.w: In the assemblies bless God, YHWH, from the fountain of Israel.

27.w: There [is] little Benjamin leading them, [with] the princes of Judah [in] their company, the princes of Zebulun, the princes of Naphtali.

28.w: Summon, O God, your strength! Make strong, O God, this which You have done for us.

29.w: Your temple [is] upon Jerusalem—the kings shall bring a gift to You.

30.w: Rebuke the creature of the reed, the herd of bulls with the calves of the nations—trample underfoot the desire for silver, scatter the nations delighting in war!

31.w: Envoys will come from Egypt; Cush will make its hands run to God.

32.w: O kingdoms of the earth, sing to God; sing praises to the Lord—Selah

33.w: to the one riding on the heavens, the heavens of old! Behold, He gives forth with His voice, a voice of power.

34.w: Ascribe strength to God, [for] His majesty [is] over Israel, and His power in the clouds.

35.w: [You are] fearsome, O God, in Your sanctuary; the God of Israel—He [is] giving power and strength to the people. Blessed be God!
